diagnosis.observed: Caller-to-agent audio is missing at the agent's end, per the complaint. Our fs-media-3 received RTP from the agent (in=6335, loss=1) and sent RTP to the agent (out=6337). It also received and sent healthy RTP on the caller leg (in=6338, out=6336). The agent's SDP had private IP 192.168.1.23:11800, but FreeSWITCH corrected it to 203.0.113.77:40112, and the agent-leg stats show that same remote. The caller leg was sent to 192.0.2.52:31044, which matches the carrier SDP. No re-INVITE appears. The agent-to-caller direction works. Packets sent by our server do not prove the agent's phone received them.
diagnosis.suspected_cause: Guess: Something on the agent's side (office firewall/NAT, or the Polycom VVX 450 or its handset) is dropping or not playing the inbound RTP.
diagnosis.visibility_ends_at: Our last view is fs-media-3 sending RTP to 203.0.113.77:40112, the agent's public NAT address. We cannot see whether it crossed the Globex firewall/NAT, reached the phone, or was played.

diagnosis.confidence: Moderate. This was found by ruling out. The platform and carrier are ruled out because RTP was healthy in both directions on both legs, and each stream went to the newest media address, with NAT corrected on the agent leg. We cannot tell a firewall/NAT drop from a phone or handset fault, and we have no data beyond our send.
